entries.revision_reason: Material evidence landed after entry 17 registered (2026-08-09), dominated by the forecast-deciding Amendment 11 convention-probe verdict of 2026-08-11. (1) The probe, executed read-only against the authenticated corpus pinned at master 60289833 (43 codebook PDFs plus 4 official Stata/SPSS setup files, 114,875,090 bytes, zero hash mismatches), found NO broad official PSID missing-data convention: the only authenticated semantic convention is the 2021 CATI note (Don't Know and NA/Refused indistinguishable for CATI cases), explicitly bound by 12 variables in the 2021 family codebook plus 12 variable-local 2023 row statements whose referenced global note (ER82001) is absent from the 2023 codebook; the four setup files declare no missing-value machinery at all (no Stata mvdecode/extended missing, no SPSS MISSING VALUES); and lexeme-only rules are provably unsound (codes 8 and 9 recur as August and September in date fields; a lexeme-level Boolean commits at least 22,849 minimal modal errors, with 4,062 conflicts inside the top-100 pair slice alone).
